entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Sam. How can I assist you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this stupid VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's junk.
I understand your frustration, sir. I'm sorry for the wait. I'm happy to help you process a return for your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number, please?
It's… hold on… #VF789234. Look, I don't have all day. This thing doesn’t track my sleep properly, and the heart rate is all over the place. I need this done now.

Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order here. A VeloBand Pulse purchased 15 days ago. I understand you'd like to return it. No problem, sir. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after purchase. So, you're well within that window.
90 days? Seriously? Took you long enough to get to the point. So, what's the next step? I don’t want a store credit or anything. I want my money back.

Absolutely. I can process a full refund back to your original payment method. To initiate the return, I'll send you a prepaid shipping label via email. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location.
Alright, that sounds acceptable. How long will it take to get my refund?
Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse at our warehouse, it typically takes 7-10 business days for the refund to be processed and reflected in your account.
Okay, that’s fine. As long as it doesn't take longer than that. I hope the next smart watch I buy actually works.
I understand. We strive for quality, and I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse didn't meet your expectations. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that’s it. Thanks for your help. I was expecting a hassle, but you made it pretty easy.

You're very welcome, sir. We appreciate your business. We understand that sometimes products don't meet every individual's needs. Although the VeloBand Pulse wasn't the right fit, perhaps a different device, like the VeloFit Apex, would suit your requirements better next time. Have a great day!
Okay, I’ll check it out. Bye.

Goodbye. If you have any further questions, don't hesitate to call back. The return policy information can also be found on our website. A manager is always available if needed. Thank you again for choosing VeloFit.
